items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 29 October 2026 9:41pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 29 October 2026 at 9:35pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds in west.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the east of the British Isles and deep area of low pressure near Greenland.


##Wind##

South or southeast 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in the west overnight. Decreasing 3 or 4 in the evening tomorrow.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, although remaining slight in the southeast. Falling slight later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mainly good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southeast 3 or 4, slowly veering south or southwest Saturday afternoon, then west or northwest later.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, risk of mist or fog patches in the east overnight into Saturday.


##Visibility##

Mainly good, risk of poor or very poor in the east later.
